teacher_spotcheck.caveat: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. Different reference (teacher / feature vector / different labeler), different corpus, different protocol, and in the H3v2 rows a different UNIT (filing-level correlation vs chunk-level proportion). No difference interval is computed — newcombe() is struck (design §7).

share_of_reference_NEGATIVE_rows_whose_s.note: NOT recall against an independent NEGATIVE ground truth. One-directional verification: only disagreements are ever re-checked, so the reference-NEGATIVE set is built from contested rows and this denominator is definitionally near the stored-NEGATIVE-and-upheld set — a value at or near 1.0 is near-structural, not a measurement of NEGATIVE detection.

sentiment.caveat: Chunk-level label accuracy under the §1.2 applicability mask (MDA + EX99_PRESS_RELEASE). Omitted stored values are scored as errors (§1.3); S-OMIT restates the rate with them excluded. This is NOT EXPANSION_PLAN §2a's feature-level reliability lambda and must not be used as one (§6.5).

guidance_direction.caveat: A PASS on guidance-P is a statement about the NONE mass only. Of the 119 EX99 rows in P (realized draw), 60 are guidance_imputed_none=true rows scored AS NONE by the §1.3 writer rule and only 9 carry an active direction, so the bar can be cleared almost entirely by the writer rule being right about the NONE mass. It is NOT evidence about the RAISED / LOWERED / MAINTAINED / WITHDRAWN calls that drive guidance_signed_mean. G-A's active precision (pooled, corpus-re-weighted) and G-N's false-NONE rate must be quoted in every table where the guidance verdict appears, and no headline may cite the guidance verdict alone.

disclosures.labels: These labels are model-produced, not human ground truth. G2 (model-consensus with owner rulings): sentiment agreement 86.94% [82.93%, 90.13%], n = 337 -- INDETERMINATE; sentiment NEGATIVE recall 0.529 (64/121) on this labeler's own held-out eval, and G2 stored-NEGATIVE precision 25/49 (51%) -- the share of chunks STORED NEGATIVE whose reference value was also NEGATIVE, summed from secondaries.S-ERR.sentiment.confusion_stored_x_reference -- is one-directional verification of contested rows and is NOT recall against independent ground truth. Guidance agreement 96.64% [91.68%, 98.69%], n = 119 is a statement about the NONE mass only and travels with ACTIVE precision 68.67% [58.17%, 77.55%], and its false-NONE rate is 0.00% (0/80) [0.00%, 4.58%] -- see G2_FINAL_REPORT.md §0 (the owner's binding interpretation: NONE may hide newly issued guidance). Red flags: exact-set error 28.00% [23.83%, 32.59%], n = 400, and the block is exploratory / disclosure-only (owner ruling 2026-08-27); this pass cannot change it -- measured on top of a v1.2 TEACHER spot-check exact-set error of 42.00% (84/200). Source: data/f4/g2/results_g2.json, sha256 d146e5e43586.
disclosures.train_overlap: Three different questions, all stated: chunk level, 4.53% of 316,291 labeled chunks overlap the labeler's own fine-tuning split (G2 census); filing level, 34.28% of the 7,381 filings in this analysis frame carry at least one such chunk (train_overlap_share > 0); company level, 108 of 143 companies (75.5%) carry at least one overlapping chunk. A chunk-level share, a filing-level share and a company-level share are not the same quantity and none of them bounds the others.
disclosures.extraction: 10 universe CIKs have no extracted periodic sections at all (148 10-K/10-Q filings never extracted), 7 of them financials -- a sector-concentrated hole, not a random one (census_e2.json, never_extracted_periodic).
disclosures.fx: Enbridge (CIK 895728) reports in Canadian dollars and enters this run UNCONVERTED -- the disclosed exception of decision 7 (owner 2026-09-11); no FX code path exists yet, and 48 of the filings in this frame are that company's.
disclosures.missing_embedding: 25 of the rows this scorecard scores sit on filings with no embedding vector, and 19 of them received a published call (44 rows on the modeling frame carry none, 45 on the three-way join before the null-target drop); those rows are fitted and scored with NaN embedding components under XGBoost's missing-value handling -- numeric plus the legacy text columns only.
disclosures.price_censoring: 31 of 244 universe members have no usable prices (counts from the target manifest); the cause is not separately measured, so they are not described as delistings; the direction is that dead-name exclusion understates downside dispersion and overstates the benchmark.
disclosures.returns: Price return only -- dividends not included; no transaction costs, taxes, slippage or position sizing; out-of-fold, backtested, no money invested.
disclosures.peer_benchmark: The peer benchmark is the equal-weighted average of all universe members, both strata, GLD excluded, excluding the company itself; 8 GLD rows were removed from this analysis frame before any fold (decision 2).
